summary: Change-observability agent that models infrastructure dependencies before changes ship.
editor_note: Infrastructure review moves before deployment: an agent builds a live model across code, cloud, CI/CD, and on-premises systems, then evaluates the blast radius of a proposed change. Unlike postmortem copilots, it intervenes before production, and more than sixty named integrations make the scope inspectable. The bet is timely as coding agents raise change volume; stale dependency models could still block safe work or miss real risk.

product_evidence.claim: empirik models dependencies across code, cloud, delivery, and on-premises systems so teams can assess blast radius before infrastructure changes ship.
The public integration catalog spans more than sixty infrastructure systems and the launch announcement says the product is already running in enterprise environments.

market_context.primary_user: Platform, SRE, security, and infrastructure teams reviewing machine-speed software changes.
market_context.differentiation: A continuously updated system model evaluates intent and dependencies before change, rather than accelerating diagnosis after an outage.
market_context.why_now: Coding agents are increasing change volume faster than ticket queues and manual review boards can assess infrastructure impact.

risks.claim: An incomplete or stale dependency model could either miss blast radius or add friction to safe routine changes.
risks.basis: The product's value depends on the operational graph remaining synchronized across a large and heterogeneous integration surface.
